source: RED-Green Belt Siem Reap network, facilitated with support from GIZ (German development cooperation) and Cambodian government partners, trifold brochure "វិធីដាំខ្នុរ" (How to Plant Jackfruit); practical training content credited to Ms. Chan Vin (អ្នកស្រី ចាន់វិន), a fruit-tree seedling vendor near Boeung Tonle Vil, Siem Reap; no publication date visible on the document.
text:
The brochure lists local vendors in Siem Reap where farmers can buy fruit-tree seedlings (general fruit-tree nursery sellers, not exclusively jackfruit):

1. Ms. Chan Vin, fruit-tree seedling seller, near Boeung Tonle Vil, Siem Reap district/khan, Siem Reap city. Phone: 012 35 10 30 / 017 68 84 49.

2. Mr. Tim Sophea, fruit-tree seedling seller, Bopha Angkor Garden, Siem Reap city. Phone: 012 98 06 23.

3. Mr. Tim Nom, fruit-tree seedling seller, Ai Daen Garden, Siem Reap city. Phone: 012 31 20 55.

4. Mr. Van Heurn, fruit-tree seedling seller, near Amphov Market, Prasat Bakong district, Siem Reap province. Phone: 012 70 80 43.

5. Ms. Kim Saret, fruit-tree seedling seller, Sandya village, Siem Reap district/khan, Siem Reap city. Phone: 089 80 54 66.

The practical training/demonstration for this brochure was presented by Ms. Chan Vin (listed as vendor #1 above), fruit-tree seedling seller, near Boeung Tonle Vil, Siem Reap khan, Siem Reap city, phone 012 35 10 30.
